title: Canonical hover payload (compiler Task 1)
description: The reusable source-of-truth for a rich hover: one canonical content identity, transcluded to many occurrences via full-carrier bindings. canonical_payload_id is content-addressed over (payload_family, surface_norm, root, lemma_id, pos, pattern, public_payload); mutable lemma/certification status, timestamps, and private_trace are excluded. public_payload is source-clean (src=qamus, kind=authored, lang=en; no external label); segment surfaces concatenate to the visible qword. Dry-run; deterministic; source-clean.
migration: @2 removes mutable lemma_status, sarf_certification, and nahw_certification from canonical payload identity while retaining the row fields. The coordinated binding identity field change causes one intentional binding-id churn because ids are content-addressed over the new field set; canonical_wbw_loc remains load-bearing so loc corrections also migrate binding ids. Existing @1 sample fixtures remain valid history and are not rewritten.

payload_family.description: RM-21 unified authorization enum -- CANONICAL (split) spelling, identical vocabulary to binding_gate. The certified-lemma fanout_gate's fused lemma_pattern_pos aliases certified_lemma + certified_pattern. See tools/validate_schema_coherence.py.

surface_norm.description: Normalized visible surface, PINNED to the `_join_surface_key` normalizer in tools/validate_largelexicon_denominator_join.py (NFC; drops whitespace, tatweel U+0640, and Qur'anic annotation marks U+06D6..U+06ED; folds ٱ->ا; KEEPS harakat and hamza seats so function-token homographs like مِن/مَن do not collapse on a loc join). surface_norm MUST be a fixed point of that normalizer (round-trip stable); the schema-coherence lint enforces `_join_surface_key(surface_norm) == surface_norm`.

private_trace.description: Internal evidence; EXCLUDED from canonical_payload_id and stripped before publication.
